Why HDXCLOUD

Clarity over marketing noise

Every claim on this website reflects the actual HDXCLOUD offering. No fabricated uptime promises, no invented statistics.

Transparent RAM pricing

Every Minecraft plan is priced per GB of RAM per month — no hidden setup fees or bundled line items.

Three hardware tiers

Cheap, Budget, and Performance tiers separate hardware generations so you can match cost and capability.

SSD storage included

SSD storage is included with every Minecraft hosting plan rather than sold as an add-on.

Configurable RAM up to 32 GB

Select the RAM allocation you need online and see the monthly total update instantly.

External client billing

Orders, renewals, and invoices are handled through the dedicated HDXCLOUD billing panel.

Separate VPS / VM portal

Virtual servers live in their own control panel, keeping game hosting and VPS management distinct.

Custom RAM via support

Larger requirements beyond the online 32 GB limit are handled through a Discord support ticket.

FAQ

Answers to common questions

Everything here reflects the current HDXCLOUD service configuration.

HDXCLOUD is a hosting brand offering RAM-priced Minecraft hosting with SSD storage included, plus a separate VPS / VM portal for virtual servers. Client billing and VPS / VM management are handled through external control panels.

Minecraft hosting starts at ₹10 per GB of RAM per month on the Cheap plan, ₹20 per GB per month on the Budget plan, and ₹30 per GB per month on the Performance plan. All prices are shown in INR.

Total monthly price equals selected RAM (in GB) multiplied by the plan's per-GB rate. For example, 4 GB on the Cheap plan is ₹40 per month, 4 GB on the Budget plan is ₹80, and 4 GB on the Performance plan is ₹120.

The Cheap plan uses an Intel Xeon E5-2620 v4 CPU. The Budget plan uses the Intel Xeon 6 family. The Performance plan uses either an AMD EPYC 9755 or an Intel Core Ultra 9, depending on the hosting node assigned to your order. All three are RAM-priced and include SSD storage.

Yes. SSD storage is included with all Minecraft hosting plans. The exact storage allocation depends on the selected plan and RAM.

Online Minecraft plans currently support selections from 1 GB to 32 GB of RAM.

Yes. If you need more than 32 GB of RAM, contact HDXCLOUD support through a Discord ticket once the official invite is published for custom requirements.

Minecraft and general services are managed from the Client Area. Virtual servers are managed from the VPS / VM Panel.

VPS and VM services are managed through the dedicated portal at vms.hdxclouds.com.

Documentation, terms, and policies are published at docs.hdxclouds.info.

Support is available through the Client Area and through Discord once the official invite is published. For documentation and policies, visit docs.hdxclouds.info.
